card.name: Directions in boundary descriptions
card.fires_on: Direction words such as west, north, east, front or behind that name where something lies or what borders it. They appear in geography or anatomy descriptions, usually after 'the' or 'in'.

modes.label: Compass directions in geography
modes.description: West, north or east after 'to the' or 'in the' when describing borders or regions of a country.
